name: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides in from an edge of the screen. Almost entirely focus management: focus moves in, is trapped while modal, and returns to the trigger on close.
demoNote: Same behavior on a phone and on a desktop — that is what separates it from the Custom Select, which anchors to its trigger at every width. Open one and press Tab repeatedly: in the first three, focus cannot leave.

contract.useWhen: A panel from a screen edge. The whole component is the focus management.
keyboard: closes, and focus returns to the trigger
cycles inside — it is trapped while the drawer is modal
failureModes: focus left behind on the page, so the next Tab starts from the top
no visible close control, which is a trap on touch where there is no Escape key
popover=auto light dismiss fighting a custom Escape handler — use manual
overflow:hidden alone for the scroll lock, which jumps the layout sideways
role=listbox on the drawer itself, instead of leaving its contents their own semantics
api: AC.createDrawer(root, options) -> { open, close, isOpen, isModal, element, destroy }
